venueText: The Museum Quarter brings together eleven institutions around Helvetiaplatz. The exact rooms will be announced here.
travelText: Bern lies at the heart of the Swiss rail network. Most international guests fly into Zurich or Geneva and continue by train. From Bern station, trams 6, 7 and 8 and bus 19 run to the Helvetiaplatz stop at the Museum Quarter.
hotelsText: EMYA2027 takes place in the same week, so we recommend booking early.
hotelsEmpty: Recommended hotels, and any special rates for participants, will be listed here.
bernTicket: Overnight guests receive the free Bern-Ticket from their hotel. It covers buses, trams and trains in zones 100/101 for the whole stay.
